Looking for a job where every day is different, you stay active, and your work truly matters? Then this could be the opportunity you’ve been looking for! Wie zoeken we? We’re looking for motivated people who are ready to roll up their sleeves and get started. You speak Dutch or English Previous logistics experience is not required You are motivated, reliable, and willing to learn You are able to provide a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG) Wat bieden wij je? At DHL, you’ll get more than just a job. You’ll get the opportunity to gain experience, develop your skills, and build a future in logistics. Gross monthly salary of €2,610 Full-time and part-time opportunities Extra pay for overtime and hours worked from 18:00 onwards 8.33% holiday allowance Travel allowance of up to €9.30 per working day Opportunities to obtain certificates for EPT, forklift, reach truck, and OPT Pension accrual after 8 working weeks Possibility of a permanent contract Opportunities for personal development and career growth Functieomschrijving At DHL Supply Chain in Wijchen/Nijmegen, you can choose between a full-time or part-time position and become part of a professional team that keeps the logistics process running smoothly. You’ll work at our modern DHL Campus, a clean, safe, and high-tech environment where teamwork and quality are at the heart of everything we do. You’ll handle a wide range of products, from everyday goods to essential pharmaceutical products. Your work helps make sure these products reach the right place at the right time. What you do has a real impact. What will you do? As a Warehouse Employee, you are an important link in the logistics process. Together with your colleagues, you make sure orders are processed accurately and prepared for shipment. Your responsibilities include: Picking and preparing customer orders for shipment Counting, checking, and managing inventory Printing labels and preparing packages Processing returns accurately Packing shipments and preparin

them for transport No two days are exactly the same, and you’ll be working in a team where everyone plays an important role. No experience? No problem! You don’t need previous logistics experience to get started. We’ll teach you everything you need to know. Because you’ll be working with pharmaceutical products, accuracy and quality are extremely important. That’s why you’ll receive a comprehensive onboarding and training program from day one. You’ll learn the processes step by step and receive support from experienced colleagues. And your development doesn’t stop there. At DHL, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to learn new skills, obtain valuable certificates, and grow within the company. You could even progress into a role such as Team Leader in the future! Would you like to be part of the logistics team at DHL Supply Chain in Wijchen? Have you become enthusiastic about this position or do you have any questions? Ask your question via WhatsApp or apply directly via the button!
